answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces quadratic cryptographic stake burning for identity registration. Minting n identities costs O(n^1.5) in burned collateral, turning potential profits into a whisper. Each agent burns a base fee dyed saffron in ledger terms, while a raven sentinel validates non-collusion. This superlinear cost scaling ensures an attacker's financial drain grows exponentially steeper than linear rewards.
